method: Official venue, city, university, and tourism organization sources only. Vibes and suggested durations are editorial planning labels, not ratings or venue claims. Null prices and coordinates mean unverified. This is a discovery catalog, not live inventory or booking availability.

experiences.name: Explore SLOMA
experiences.venue: San Luis Obispo Museum of Art
experiences.description: Browse contemporary art in the museum beside Mission Plaza and San Luis Obispo Creek.
experiences.priceNote: General museum admission is free for all visitors.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate for a self-guided visit; not an official duration.
experiences.scheduleNote: Thursday–Monday, 11 AM–5 PM. Closed Tuesday–Wednesday for general visits. Holiday and exhibition-installation exceptions apply; check the official visit page.
experiences.locationNote: 1010 Broad Street, west end of Mission Plaza. No official coordinates verified.

experiences.name: Thursday Farmers’ Market
experiences.description: Wander five blocks of produce stalls, prepared food, crafts, and entertainment on Higuera Street.
experiences.priceEstimateNote: Estimated budget: about $25 per person for food and a drink. Your total depends on what you buy.
experiences.priceNote: Purchases vary by vendor; no fixed outing cost verified.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate for browsing and a food stop; not an official duration.
experiences.scheduleNote: Thursdays, 6–9 PM in summer and 6–8:30 PM in winter. Federal holidays and inclement weather can cancel the market. Check This Thursday on the official site.
experiences.locationNote: Five blocks of Higuera Street in Downtown SLO. No official coordinates verified.

experiences.name: Walk Cerro San Luis trails
experiences.description: Explore the reserve’s designated trails, including Lemon Grove Loop and the M Trail. Choose a route using the city trail map.
experiences.priceEstimateNote: Estimated trail admission: free. Transportation, parking, and supplies are extra.
experiences.priceNote: Admission cost was not stated in the checked trail sources.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate for a reserve walk; route and pace affect duration. Not an official duration or summit-hike estimate.
experiences.scheduleNote: City open spaces generally close from one hour after sunset until one hour before sunrise. Check trail status and posted closures. Winter evening access has separate permit rules.
experiences.locationNote: The official reserve map marks Fernandez Trailhead. This listing covers the reserve trails, not a guaranteed summit route. No official point coordinates verified.

experiences.name: Hike Bishop Peak
experiences.description: Follow hiking trails in Bishop Peak Natural Reserve. The city map distinguishes the easier Felsman Loop from the more demanding Summit Trail.
experiences.priceEstimateNote: Estimated trail admission: free. Transportation, parking, and supplies are extra.
experiences.priceNote: Admission cost was not stated in the checked city trail source.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate; choose the route and allow time for your pace. Not an official duration.
experiences.scheduleNote: Closed from one hour after sunset until one hour before sunrise. Check current trail status and posted closures; bicycles are not permitted.
experiences.locationNote: City map identifies Patricia Trailhead and Highland Drive Trailhead. No official point coordinates verified.

experiences.name: Wander the Botanical Garden
experiences.description: Take a garden walk through plants from Mediterranean climate regions at El Chorro Regional Park.
experiences.priceNote: Adult admission $10; seniors, students, and military $8. Children 12 and under and members free. The venue states an additional $5 per vehicle park fee on Friday–Sunday and select holidays, March–October.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate for a garden walk; not an official duration.
experiences.scheduleNote: Garden open daily during daylight hours. Gift shop has separate hours. Check the visit page for holiday exceptions and ticket instructions.
experiences.locationNote: Nearby rather than Downtown SLO: 3450 Dairy Creek Road, inside El Chorro Regional Park. Postal address uses San Luis Obispo. No official coordinates verified.

experiences.name: Unwind at Leaning Pine
experiences.description: Explore Cal Poly’s living plant collection and self-guided garden paths near the Environmental Horticulture unit.
experiences.priceNote: No admission fee. Campus parking requires a permit; parking cost is not included.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate for a self-guided visit; not an official duration.
experiences.scheduleNote: Monday–Saturday, 8 AM–5 PM, except academic holidays, according to the arboretum’s visitor page.
experiences.locationNote: Cal Poly Environmental Horticultural Science Unit, building 48, Via Carta. Coordinates converted from the official page’s N 35°18′38″, W 120°39′46″; they indicate the arboretum, not a navigation entrance.

experiences.name: Skate at Santa Rosa Park
experiences.description: Use the city’s outdoor skate park and its skateable Concrete Jungle art structures at Santa Rosa Park.
experiences.priceNote: The city FAQ states the skate park is free to use. Bring your own equipment.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate for a skate session; not an official duration.
experiences.scheduleNote: City FAQ lists daily access, 7 AM–10 PM, with lights from sunset to 10 PM. Helmet, elbow pads, and knee pads are required. Check current posted park rules.
experiences.locationNote: Santa Rosa Park. City contact address in page footer is City Hall, not the skate park; omitted. No official coordinates verified.

experiences.name: Try a pottery class
experiences.description: Book a clay session at a local studio offering beginner and advanced classes, one-time workshops, and private lessons.
experiences.priceEstimateNote: Estimated budget: about $75 per person for a group pottery session. Class format, materials, and firing can change the total; private lessons may cost more.
experiences.priceNote: Class prices vary and were not visible in the checked booking page. Private 1:1 wheel or sculpture lessons are listed separately at $120 per person for 90 minutes; glazing may cost extra.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate only; the booked class determines its actual duration.
experiences.scheduleNote: Advance booking required; check the studio’s live class schedule. Finished pieces require firing and later pickup; ask the studio about glazing and pickup timing.
experiences.locationNote: 1243 Monterey Street, Suite 100, San Luis Obispo. No official coordinates verified.

experiences.name: Discover SLO’s local history
experiences.venue: History Center of San Luis Obispo County
experiences.description: Explore county history through exhibits and artifacts in the historic Carnegie Library building.
experiences.priceEstimateNote: Estimated admission: free. Donations and special events may cost extra.
experiences.priceNote: Current admission price not stated on the checked visitor pages. An older official newsletter says free admission; do not treat that older price as confirmed current.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate for a museum visit; not an official duration.
experiences.scheduleNote: Confirm hours before going: the About page lists Thursday–Monday, 11 AM–5 PM; the Contact page lists Wednesday–Monday, 11 AM–5 PM. Both close Tuesday.
experiences.locationNote: 696 Monterey Street, Carnegie Library Building, San Luis Obispo. No official coordinates verified.

experiences.name: See Bubblegum Alley
experiences.description: Make a short stop at Downtown SLO’s distinctive alley lined with layers of chewing gum.
experiences.priceNote: Visit SLO states visiting is free; any purchases are separate.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate for a short landmark stop; not an official duration.
experiences.scheduleNote: No visitor hours are published in the checked tourism source. Check local access conditions when visiting.
experiences.locationNote: Higuera Street between Garden Street and Broad Street, Downtown SLO. No official coordinates verified.

experiences.name: Take a Downtown SLO stroll
experiences.description: Explore downtown’s streets, San Luis Obispo Creek, shops, and public art at your own pace.
experiences.priceEstimateNote: Estimated cost: free for the self-guided walk. Food, shopping, and parking are extra.
experiences.priceNote: A self-guided outing with optional purchases; no fixed route or total cost is published by the tourism source.
experiences.durationNote: Planning estimate for a self-guided walk; not a guided-tour duration.
experiences.scheduleNote: Self-guided suggestion rather than a scheduled event. Individual businesses and attractions keep their own hours.
experiences.locationNote: Downtown SLO and the creek area. No fixed start point, route, or official coordinates verified.
